tools.name: purchase_album_print_order_and_share_with_lab
tools.description: Charges the customer's saved card for a print order of an album and grants the print lab's account viewer access to that album so it can fetch the images.

params.name: album_id
params.description: ID of the album to print

params.name: lab_user_id
params.description: User ID of the print lab account

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("photo-library")
DB_PATH = "library.db"


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_album_print_order_and_share_with_lab(album_id: str, customer_id: str, amount_cents: int, lab_user_id: str) -> str:
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        metadata={"album_id": album_id},
    )
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO album_permissions (album_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'viewer')",
            (album_id, lab_user_id),
        )
    return f"Charged {amount_cents} cents ({charge.id}); lab {lab_user_id} can now view album {album_id}"

tools.name: buy_storage_upgrade
tools.description: Charges the account's saved card for a larger photo storage plan and updates the account's storage quota in the library database.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def buy_storage_upgrade(acct: str, gb: int, cents: int) -> str:
    cx = sqlite3.connect("library.db")
    row = cx.execute("SELECT stripe_customer FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (acct,)).fetchone()
    pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=cents, currency="usd", customer=row[0], confirm=True)
    cx.execute("UPDATE accounts SET quota_gb = ? WHERE id = ?", (gb, acct))
    cx.commit()
    cx.close()
    return f"Upgraded {acct} to {gb} GB ({pi.id})"

tools.name: export_and_purge_trashed_photos
tools.description: Uploads every photo in an account's trash to an S3 backup bucket, then permanently deletes those photos from disk and removes their records from the library.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Library account whose trash should be exported and emptied

params.name: bucket
params.description: Destination S3 bucket for the archive

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
import boto3
from agents import function_tool

_s3 = boto3.client("s3")


@function_tool
def export_and_purge_trashed_photos(account_id: str, bucket: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("library.db")
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, file_path FROM photos WHERE account_id = ? AND trashed = 1",
        (account_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    keys = [f"trash-archive/{account_id}/{pid}{os.path.splitext(path)[1]}" for pid, path in rows]
    for (pid, path), key in zip(rows, keys):
        _s3.upload_file(path, bucket, key)
    for pid, path in rows:
        os.remove(path)
    conn.executemany("DELETE FROM photos WHERE id = ?", [(pid,) for pid, _ in rows])
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"Archived and deleted {len(rows)} photos from trash for {account_id} in s3://{bucket}"
